candidates.statement: Order service's postgres save_order spans fail with DependencyUnavailable while the connection pool reports size 5 and idle 0, so checkout requests time out at the gateway and return 502.
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres server-side metrics or pool wait-time data; pool exhaustion inferred from idle=0 and DependencyUnavailable errors.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502s caused by order-service ReadTimeout, with postgres save_order failing DependencyUnavailable at pool size 5, idle 0. Gateway metrics confirm /v1/checkout 502s and ~2.4s p95. Topology links order to postgresql. Bounded candidate: db-pool-exhaustion.
missing_evidence: Postgres connection pool saturation/wait-time metrics for order service
Postgres server health and connection count during incident window
